metadata.title: Choose the Smallest Useful Rule
metadata.description: Combine divisibility, repeated digits, prime factors, digit counts, and number properties in exam-style mixed problems.

content.text: Mixed number-system questions reward diagnosis. Ask what the target depends on: last digits, digit sum, alternating sum, factorization, place value, or magnitude.

Do not automatically calculate the whole expression. A repeated-digit number may have a known factorization; a divisibility question may depend on only two or three digits; a digit-count question may be solved by size bounds.
Let's combine magnitude reasoning with a digit-count question.
When two methods are available, prefer the one that removes intermediate variables or discards irrelevant digits. That is both faster and safer under exam pressure.
Now use structure inside a repeated-1 number.
You have the full Number System toolkit: classify, factor, test divisibility, exploit identities, and reduce large powers to small patterns.
